folg_med.hendelse: Investigation into fuel prices at Icelandic pumps
folg_med.hvorfor: Samkeppniseftirlitið (Icelandic Competition Authority) plans to investigate whether Icelandic consumers have benefited from falling global fuel prices. The authority has requested information from oil companies to assess how fuel prices in Iceland have developed compared with prices abroad. Samkeppniseftirlitið announced the investigation today. It noted that fuel prices had begun falling rapidly on international markets in November, and that, Consumer and trade union organisations have publicly claimed that oil companies have increased their profit margins under these circumstances.
